text:
zoe (recruiter): Quick coordination: Candidate Elena Morales (L4 Data Sci) requested an ASL interpreter for her on-site loop next Tue. Also asked for a private lactation room and a vegetarian lunch. Can ops book interpreter + confirm room?

alistair (hiring mgr): Thanks for flagging. Proposed schedule: remote screen 10:00-10:30 PT, onsite panel 11:15-13:00 PT. Elena is flying in same morning; said shed need the lactation room midday. Can we compress panels to finish by 13:00?

rina (people-ops): We can arrange ASL interpreter through our vendor (InterpretsRUs) and reserve lactation room + quiet panel room. Interpreter booking needs full candidate name, timezone, and whether remote or in-person interpretation is preferred. They bill by half-hour.

accessibility-bot: Note: company policy pays for reasonable accommodations including interpreter fees and lactation room access. Please confirm whether interpreter should be on-site or remote. If on-site, we need a 24h lead time for confirmation.

it-support-bot: If the interpreter will join remote, we can include them on the Zoom link and patch audio in the room. Also can reserve a wireless lapel mic for clearer audio.

zoe (recruiter): Elena prefers in-person interpreter if possible. Candidate details: Elena Morales, pronouns she/her, phone 650-555-0142, local arrival 2026-11-02 08:40am. I'll ask her to confirm preference if anything changes.

facilities-bot: Lactation room reserved (Room L1) 11:30-12:15. Conf C (quiet panel) reserved 11:00-13:15 for buffer. Visitor parking V9 reserved 10:45-14:00. Front desk to prepare a printed accommodations checklist for candidate.

rina (people-ops): I've initiated interpreter request (InterpretsRUs) for in-person coverage 11:00-13:00. ETA vendor confirmation: 6-12h. Estimated cost: $120 (2 hours). We'll code expense to HIRING-ACCOMMS.

alistair (hiring mgr): Two asks: 1) Add a line in the invite: "Accommodation: ASL interpreter + lactation room reserved" so interviewers are aware. 2) Please disable recording for the loop; interpreter consent to recording must be explicit.

it-support-bot: Zoom fallback link added; recording disabled by default. If any interviewer insists on a recording, we need written consent from candidate + interpreter and legal signoff.

zoe (recruiter): Elena confirmed in-person interpreter is preferred and appreciated the lactation room. She also asked whether we can provide a quiet space for nursing if lactation room is occupied. Rina, can we have a backup quiet office?

rina (people-ops): Yes, backup quiet room Conf F reserved 11:30-12:30. We'll label it "Private - accommodations" and notify reception to avoid interruptions.

accessibility-bot: Reminder: please provide the interpreter with the loop agenda and interviewer names 24h ahead. I'll attach a short agenda file to the vendor request.

zoe (recruiter): Sent agenda to interpreter contact and included interviewer bios. Also added a one-line accessibility blurb in the invite for interviewers: "Please avoid surprise schedule changes; be mindful of accessibility needs."

candidate-bot: Elena replied: "Thanks everyone. I confirm in-person interpreter and will arrive at 10:45. I will bring my own snacks; vegetarian lunch voucher is fine. See you Tuesday."

rina (people-ops): Vendor confirmed interpreter booking. Invoice note will go to finance; candidate-facing logistics email sent with parking + reception pickup instructions.

alistair (hiring mgr): Appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll remind interviewers to keep debriefs under 20m given candidate has travel constraints.

it-support-bot: Lapel mic & spare charger reserved at reception.

rina (people-ops): Final checklist posted in invite: ASL interpreter on-site 11:00-13:00, Lactation Room L1 reserved 11:30-12:15, Backup quiet room Conf F, Parking V9, Lunch voucher (vegetarian). Closing thread  reopen if anything changes.
